summary:
Iteration 7 verified the 4 deposit UX tweaks end-to-end (frontend refactor). Backend pytest regression 59/59 still 100% passing. Frontend E2E on 428x900 mobile viewport with user +2348047969299/pass1234 (has 2 seeded active payment_accounts: ACCESS BANK/0123456789 & GTCO/9876543210):
1) /deposit — 0 PayNow occurrences in visible body; 0 'manual' occurrences; no 'Or transfer to one of our banks' phrase.
2) deposit-methods-grid has class grid-cols-3, exactly 3 aspect-square blocks: deposit-method-instant ('Instant Pay' / 'Auto credit'), deposit-method-<id> for ACCESS BANK (AB avatar) and GTCO (G avatar), each labelled with bank name and account number.
3) Amount input disabled when no method picked, yellow hint deposit-pick-method-hint visible; picking a manual block enables amount, reveals deposit-selected-panel with copy button + optional deposit-reference-input, submit label = 'Submit for approval'; picking Instant hides both selected-panel and reference-input, submit label flips to 'Pay instantly'.
4) top-right deposit-history-link navigates to /deposit-history; no inline table on /deposit.
5) /deposit-history — all testids present (deposit-history-page, hist-heading, hist-back-link, hist-tab-{all,pending,approved,rejected}, hist-search-input); back arrow returns to /deposit; empty state shown for the primary QA user (0 deposits). Search filters rows correctly.
6) Load-more E2E — seeded 12 deposits as TEST_UserA (+2348052809027, ended up with 15 total). Initial view showed exactly 10 hist-row-* cards + 'Load more (5)' button + counter 'Showing 10 of 15'. Clicking hist-load-more revealed all 15 rows, button hid, counter updated to 'Showing 15 of 15'. Switching to Pending tab then back to All correctly reset visible to 10 and the Load-more button reappeared with 'Showing 10 of 15'. Search 'TEST_LM_5' filtered to 1 row.
7) /bank-account and /profile — 0 PayNow occurrences (all copy replaced with generic wording per spec).
8) Backend regression pytest: 59 passed in 18.02s (no changes vs iteration 6).
critical_code_review_comments: DepositHistory.jsx re-exports StatusPill from /pages/user/Deposit.jsx creating a cross-page import for a small pill component — consider moving StatusPill to /components/ui or a shared /components/StatusPill.jsx to avoid coupling two pages.

MethodLabel in DepositHistory.jsx falls back to `d.reference` when payment_account_bank is missing, but the reference is also shown separately on the same card (Ref: ...) — this doubles the reference display for older manual deposits without enrichment. Consider showing literal 'Manual' when payment_account_bank is missing rather than reference.

Deposit.jsx clipboard writeText handler (unchanged from iter-6) still shows 'Copied' toast on success path only via try/catch — still fine, but a rejection path is now wrapped so the dev-mode overlay observed in iter-6 should not recur.

In Deposit.jsx, the polling interval in useEffect for the waiting drawer never cancels via a cleanup that also clears state — the setInterval is cleared on effect unmount, but if waitState changes to 'approved'/'rejected' the polling continues until the next re-render tears it down. Not a leak but potentially one extra call.
server.py is now 1552 lines (flagged in prior iterations) — router split still pending; not blocking.

Load-more user: +2348052809027 / pass1234 (TEST_UserA, now has 15 deposits after this run's seed of 12 Bank-method deposits with TEST_LM_0..TEST_LM_11 references).
seed_data_creation: Seeded 12 manual (method='Bank', gateway=manual) deposits as TEST_UserA (+2348052809027) with references TEST_LM_0 through TEST_LM_11 and amounts ₦500..₦511, bringing that user's total to 15 deposits (13 pending, 1 approved, 1 rejected). These enable future load-more regression testing without re-seeding. Payment accounts (ACCESS BANK/0123456789 and GTCO/9876543210) from iteration 6 are still active and visible to the primary QA user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 tweaks verified. /deposit has 3-block grid-cols-3 layout (aspect-square blocks). No PayNow branding anywhere on /deposit, /deposit-history, /bank-account, or /profile. /deposit-history is a full page with 4 tabs + counts, search input, empty state, list, load-more (step=10) with 'Showing X of Y' counter, tab switch resets visible to 10. Backend pytest 59/59 unchanged. Load-more feature verified against 15 real deposits: 10→click→15, counter and button state track correctly. No code changes were made this iteration (pure verification pass).
